Ziad KhaledB.Com · English Accounting · Sohag University

I’m building a career where accounting knowledge meets data-driven thinking.

I’m Ziad Khaled, a 2024 English Accounting graduate from Sohag University, graduating with Very Good with Honors (88.67%). During university, I was an active member of the Faculty of Commerce Quality Assurance Unit, where I took part in student reception, university activities and team-based events. I also volunteered with Life Makers Foundation in Sohag and Al-Monsha’a, contributing to community initiatives and charitable convoys.

My practical experience includes reception and customer service at Bella Rose Village in Hurghada, training with Banque Misr and ALEXBANK, and hands-on accounting work at Elkhodery Accounting Group, where I worked with document review and manual and electronic accounting records.

After completing my military service, I moved into Data Analysis, focusing on data cleaning, KPI analysis, dashboards, visualization and turning raw data into clear business insights. My goal is to combine my accounting background with analytical thinking to support better business decisions.
